actions.description: Apply a force on the object.

image-point.desc: The name or number of the image point to apply the force at. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

image-point.name: Image point
image-point.desc: The name or number of the image point to apply the force at. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

image-point.name: Image point
image-point.desc: The name or number of the image point to apply the force at. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

actions.description: Apply an impulse to the object, as if it were suddenly struck.

image-point.name: Image point
image-point.desc: The name or number of the image point to apply the impulse at. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

actions.description: Apply an impulse on the object as if it were suddenly struck towards a position in the layout.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X co-ordinate to apply the impulse towards.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y co-ordinate to apply the impulse towards.

image-point.name: Image point
image-point.desc: The name or number of the image point to apply the impulse at. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

actions.display-text: Apply {my} impulse {0} at angle {1} at image point {2}
actions.description: Apply an impulse on the object as if it were suddenly struck at an angle.

angle.name: Angle
angle.desc: The angle, in degrees, to apply the impulse at.

image-point.name: Image point
image-point.desc: The name or number of the image point to apply the impulse at. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

actions.description: Set the current motion of the physics object.

x-component.name: X component
x-component.desc: The X component of the velocity to set, in pixels per second.

y-component.name: Y component
y-component.desc: The Y component of the velocity to set, in pixels per second.

actions.description: Set the position of the physics body to a new location, preserving its velocity.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X position to teleport to.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y position to teleport to.

actions.description: Set the force of gravity on all objects in the world.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.desc: The new force of gravity to set.

actions.description: Set the way the physics engine steps the simulation.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: The stepping mode.  'Fixed' guarantees same results every time but is not framerate independent; 'framerate independent' adjusts to the framerate but may give different results each time.

actions.display-text: Set {my} world stepping to {0} velocity iterations and {1} position iterations
actions.description: Set the performance/accuracy trade-off.

velocity-iterations.name: Velocity iterations
velocity-iterations.desc: Iterations for the velocity constraint solver.  Lower is fast and inaccurate, higher is slow and accurate.

position-iterations.name: Position iterations
position-iterations.desc: Iterations for the position constraint solver.  Lower is fast and inaccurate, higher is slow and accurate.

actions.description: Enable or disable collisions with another object using the Physics behavior.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Choose another object type with the Physics behavior to enable or disable collisions for.

state.name: State
state.desc: Enable or disable collisions with the given object type.

actions.display-text: Create {my} distance joint from image point {0} to {1} image point {2}, damping ratio {3}, frequency {4}
actions.description: Force this and another object to stay a fixed distance apart, as if connected by a pole.

this-image-point.name: This image point
this-image-point.desc: Name or number of image point on this object to attach joint to. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

that-image-point.name: That image point
that-image-point.desc: Name or number of image point on other object to attach joint to.

damping-ratio.name: Damping ratio
damping-ratio.desc: The joint damping ratio, from 0 (no damping) to 1 (critical damping)

actions.display-text: Create {my} revolute joint at image point {0} to {1}
actions.description: Hinge another object to a point on this object.

this-image-point.name: This image point
this-image-point.desc: Name or number of image point on this object to hinge object to. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

actions.display-text: Create {my} limited revolute joint at image point {0} to {1}, from {2} to {3} degrees
actions.description: Hinge another object to a point on this object and limit the range of rotation.

this-image-point.name: This image point
this-image-point.desc: Name or number of image point on this object to hinge object to. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

lower-angle.name: Lower angle
lower-angle.desc: The lower angle of rotation allowed, in degrees.

upper-angle.name: Upper angle
upper-angle.desc: The upper angle of rotation allowed, in degrees.

actions.display-text: Create {my} prismatic joint at image point {0} to {1} (angle [i]{2}[/i], limit [i]{3}[/i] from [i]{4}[/i] to [i]{5}[/i], motor [i]{6}[/i] speed [i]{7}[/i] max force [i]{8}[/i])
actions.description: Restrict movement of two objects along a specific axis.

this-image-point.name: This image point
this-image-point.desc: Name or number of image point on this object to hinge object to. Use 0 for the center of gravity and -1 for the object origin.

axis-angle.name: Axis angle
axis-angle.desc: The angle of the axis to constrain movement to, in degrees.

enable-limit.name: Enable limit
enable-limit.desc: Whether to enable the lower and upper translation limits.

lower-translation.name: Lower translation
lower-translation.desc: The lower translation allowed relative to the starting position, in pixels.

upper-translation.name: Upper translation
upper-translation.desc: The upper translation allowed relative to the starting position, in pixels.

enable-motor.name: Enable motor
enable-motor.desc: Whether to enable a motor on the joint.

motor-speed.name: Motor speed
motor-speed.desc: The speed of the motor, in degrees per second.
